methods.what: First variation of a quadratic energy integral in derivatives of u plus a time-derivative term (variational form of the heat equation)
methods.quote: $\delta\iiint\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_1}^2(ab+c) + 2b\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_1}\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_2} - 2a\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_1}\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_3} + 2\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_2}\frac{\partial u}{\partial s_3}\Big)\partial s_1\partial s_2\partial s_3 + \int \delta u\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\, c\, \partial s_1\partial s_2\partial s_3$

methods.what: Expansion of a quadratic form (line element) by completing the square
Coefficient matrix of the quadratic form and its adjugate (cofactor) matrix
Pair of PDEs (heat equation f = du/dt with a second-order constraint φ = 0) whose compatibility is examined
